text_block_list.name: TV Show News Anchor
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived!
The 1st leg of the Tiara route, the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it's really bustling! Seems like there are even more spectators than usual?

text_block_list.name: TV Show News Anchor
text_block_list.text: "Well, it drew a lot of attention at 'Emperor' Symboli Rudolf's press conference the other day, after all."

text_block_list.name: TV Show News Anchor
text_block_list.text: While Classic Triple Crown Umamusume have been born back-to-back, will the very first Triple Tiara Umamusume emerge this year? We can't wait to find out!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
At last... it begins...!
Lady Mejiro Ramonu's path to supremacy!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa...! Lady Ramonu...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-What intense excitement...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, you may hold tightly
onto my arm if you wish, you know~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine, really!
...Thank you for coming along with me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Not at all~. I truly wanted to witness Lady Ramonu's grand challenge in person as well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's strange, isn't it? The Triple Tiara is
such an incredible feat that no one has ever achieved it, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The thought of Ms. Ramonu not wearing the Tiara...
it just feels completely impossible to imagine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~.
Everyone is waiting for the inevitable victory...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And Lady Ramonu herself as well...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Did I copy her hair accessory
a little too much?
Oh well... it's fine, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: Because I get to compete with Ramonu-san again in such an important race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: I've worked so hard for today. I'll show them that I can do it too... and then, maybe they'll finally acknowledge me!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
—I wonder if they'll see me as a true rival... Ah, what am I saying!
Alright, let's do this...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
The mission of our Mejiro family...
...Our dearest wish—I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right before the race, as Mejiro Ramonu prepared herself, I went over the final checks for the Oka Sho with her.
choice_data_list: What matters most is mental strength.
What matters most is mental strength, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Around this time, Umamusume who just entered the Classic Class lack experience, and with the Oka Sho being their first Classic race, the pressure is immense."
choice_data_list: Let's make sure you aren't crushed by the huge expectations...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a race where the heavy expectations of being the first favorite cause many to underperform...
having a strong mindset is the key.
choice_data_list: Believe in yourself and run all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ah, are you done?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I understand your strategy.
However—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's already perfect, after all...
There is nothing lacking in me... That is satisfactory, yes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It reminded me of her Make Debut.
She wasn't nervous back then either...
It seems my advice was unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Most of the spectators here today have their eyes on Mejiro Ramonu, full of expectation. And she herself desires nothing less—"
choice_data_list: We're definitely going to win the Triple Tiara...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even if you can't get it,
it's totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
I shall be the one upon that throne, however.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Please don't look as if
"everything is over if you can't take the Triple Tiara"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because of that, this love of mine will never run dry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara is
strictly for the family... to prove my love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It is not
my love itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You need only watch.
Just like everyone else."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In short, it seems she feels I'm "not in a position to carry burdens."
As her Trainer, she won't let me shoulder anything... Even so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "—Ever since the day I met her, my yearning for the Triple Tiara—a feat no one had ever achieved—only grew stronger."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, it was just a dream. But now...
my fingertips are beginning to touch that ultimate prize.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The one who wants to see the first Triple Tiara in history...
more than anyone else, is myself.”
choice_data_list: (So I'll have you carry it for me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Now, let us go—
choice_data_list: As a fellow race fan, I have a request.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, what kind?
choice_data_list: I'm entrusting my Triple Tiara dreams to you.
I entrust you with my hopes for the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She loves everything surrounding races.
"Feelings poured into a race"... If that's what it is,
she will surely accept it as one of those elements.
choice_data_list: Give us the best race of your life! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Good girl.
You are..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Please,
do as you wish."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: These flames will envelop everything.
